# Pull Request Summary

## What does this change do?

Describe the problem and the intended result.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI or maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci` completed.
- [ ] `npm test -- --watchAll=false` passed.
- [ ] `npm run build` passed.
- [ ] Keyboard interaction was reviewed.
- [ ] Responsive layout was reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets or generated build output were committed.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated where needed.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visible changes.

## Risks and follow-up

List known limitations, compatibility considerations, and follow-up work.
